item.title: Bowling: Kathy Howard leads Busy Bees League with 554 series
item.description: KINGSTON, N.Y. — Kathy Howard rolled a 554 series to lead the Busy Bees Bowling League at Patel’s Kingston Lanes on Thursday, Feb. 26. Howard’s high game in her league-leading series was 211.
